text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! For the yoga on the livestream,
which video should we use as a reference?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Since they went out of their way to invite me as a guest,
I certainly don't want to compromise on anything."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Once you start looking, there are so many options!
Should I play it safe and go by the number of "Umanes"?
Buuut...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then there's only one way!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Epi-san!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If we try every single one, we'll know which is best!
Let's do them all!

text_block_list.name: Yoga Video Voice A
text_block_list.text:
"Be mindful not to arch your lower back or slouch,
and let's try the Mountain Pose."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
*Deep breath... Whew~~~.*
Just paying attention to my posture
makes my mind feel straight and clear too♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... This is so relaxing, it feels great.
Yep, this is plenty good for a beginner like me♡"

text_block_list.name: Yoga Video Voice B
text_block_list.text:
"Hold up a finger, totally feel yourself!
Alright, give me that pose!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's pretty unusual!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this really works...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, on to the next one! Let's keep 'em coming!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! Finished them all!
Fifty non-stop reps!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! That really was tiring!
Feels like my whole body's boiling...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head in front of the station next!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? In front of the station...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm heading to that yoga studio right over there!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yoga isn't just whatever's in some video, right?
I'm gonna try every single kind of yoga out there!
That's what trying everything means!

text_block_list.name: Yoga Master
text_block_list.text:
Come on, New-Face-chan!
It's time for the explosion pose! Bomber!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I-It's tough... but still!
Woaaaaaaah! Bombeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: If it's for the sake of a fun stream...!

text_block_list.name: Ai & Loves
text_block_list.text: Bomberrr!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Soaking up the sunset with a full-body starfish pose— Mmmhh~~~! I feel so cleansed~~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. We were supposed to just pick out a yoga video, but to think we'd end up doing yoga out in the great outdoors."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've done plenty of yoga up until now, but
I feel like I've just opened a whole new door!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We only realized that because we tried everything!
If you're gonna do something, go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "We promise to spread the word! This deep moving experience... this ultimate yoga! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it'll definitely work out!
After all, I touched the very heart of yoga!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, more and more Umamusume could be seen
enjoying yoga all across the academy."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Palm tree poooose~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Try this pose over here too!
It stretches your back and feels so good~...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's getting healthier and healthier!
All thanks to Loves and Ai spreading the word so much!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you join me, Trainer?
It feels totally exhilarating!
choice_data_list: Then I'll take whatever you recommend!
If we're gonna do it, let's get a big group together.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, don't say it's a waste! If we're gonna do it, we go all out!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We'll try it all—videos, classes, outdoor yoga in nature!
I'm sticking with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great!
Let's get the teachers and the Trainers in on it too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go talk to every single one of them!
Look forward to it, Trainer!
